list_sessions.title: List sessions
list_sessions.description: List the project's browser sessions, optionally filtered by status or by a user-metadata query. Returns session records (id, status, region, timestamps, proxy bytes, userMetadata) without connect URLs; use get_session for one session, or get_session_live_urls for its debugger and CDP URLs.

q.description: Query sessions by user metadata, e.g. user_metadata['order']:'1234'. See the Browserbase docs on querying sessions by user metadata for the syntax.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, ERROR, TIMED_OUT or COMPLETED.

expiresAt.description: When the session will time out.

create_session.title: Create a session
create_session.description: Start a new cloud browser session. Returns the session record plus connectUrl (the CDP WebSocket URL to drive it with Playwright/Puppeteer), seleniumRemoteUrl and signingKey. The session runs (and bills) until it times out or is released with release_session. Use a context_id to reuse cookies and storage from a context made with create_context.

project_id.description: The Project ID. Optional - if not provided, the project is inferred from the API key.

extension_id.description: An uploaded Extension ID to load into the browser.

context_id.description: A Context ID (from create_context) whose cookies and storage the browser starts with.

persist_context.description: Whether to save the browser state back to the context when the session ends. Defaults to false. Only used with context_id.

viewport_width.description: The width of the browser viewport, in pixels.

viewport_height.description: The height of the browser viewport, in pixels.

block_ads.description: Enable or disable ad blocking in the browser. Defaults to false.

solve_captchas.description: Enable or disable captcha solving in the browser. Defaults to true.

record_session.description: Enable or disable session recording. Defaults to true.

log_session.description: Enable or disable session logging. Defaults to true.

verified.description: Enable Verified Browser Mode (replaces the deprecated advancedStealth).

os.description: Operating system to present in stealth mode.

captcha_image_selector.description: Custom CSS selector for the captcha image, for custom captcha solving.

captcha_input_selector.description: Custom CSS selector for the captcha input, for custom captcha solving.

allowed_domains.description: Restrict top-level page navigations to these domains and their subdomains (example.com also allows www.example.com). Empty disables the restriction; iframes and subresources are not blocked.

ignore_certificate_errors.description: Set true to ignore TLS certificate errors (expired or self-signed certificates). Defaults to false.

timeout.description: Duration in seconds after which the session automatically ends. Defaults to the project's defaultTimeout.

keep_alive.description: Keep the session alive even after disconnections. Available on the Hobby plan and above.

proxies.description: Proxy configuration. Pass true for the default Browserbase residential proxy, or an array of proxy rules, each one of: {type: 'browserbase', geolocation?: {country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, required), state (US 2-letter code), city}, domainPattern?}; {type: 'external', server (required), username?, password?, domainPattern?}; {type: 'none', domainPattern?}. domainPattern limits a rule to matching domains; omitted it applies to all. (To use the default proxy, pass [{"type": "browserbase"}].)

ca_certificates.description: IDs of uploaded TLS certificates for the proxy to trust (see list_certificates).

region.description: The region where the session should run. Defaults to us-west-2.

user_metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata to attach to the session; queryable later with list_sessions q.

output.description: The created session, including connectUrl, seleniumRemoteUrl and signingKey.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, ERROR, TIMED_OUT or COMPLETED.

expiresAt.description: When the session will time out.

connectUrl.description: WebSocket URL to connect to the session over CDP.

seleniumRemoteUrl.description: HTTP URL for Selenium remote WebDriver.

get_session.title: Get a session
get_session.description: Fetch one session by id: status, region, start/end/expiry times, proxy bytes used, keepAlive, contextId and userMetadata, plus its connectUrl. Use get_session_live_urls for the live debugger view, or list_sessions to find ids.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, ERROR, TIMED_OUT or COMPLETED.

expiresAt.description: When the session will time out.

release_session.title: Release (end) a session
release_session.description: End a running session by setting its status to REQUEST_RELEASE. Do this as soon as automation is finished to stop billing before the timeout. A released session cannot be resumed; start a new one with create_session. Returns the updated session record.

id.description: The id of the session to end.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, ERROR, TIMED_OUT or COMPLETED.

expiresAt.description: When the session will time out.

get_session_live_urls.title: Get session live view URLs
get_session_live_urls.description: Get the live view URLs for a running session: debuggerFullscreenUrl and debuggerUrl (embeddable live view / DevTools), wsUrl (CDP WebSocket), and per-page entries (id, url, title, debugger URLs). Use these to watch or hand control of a session to a human; use get_session for status.

expires_in.description: Time-to-live of the generated live view URLs, in seconds. If omitted, the URLs expire with the session (max 6 hours).

output.description: Live view URLs for the session and each open page.

pages.description: Open pages with their own debugger URLs.

get_session_logs.title: Get session logs
get_session_logs.description: Return a session's CDP event log: each entry has method, pageId, frameId, loaderId, timestamp and the request/response payloads. Use it to debug what happened in a session; logs exist only when logSession was enabled (the default).

get_session_replay.title: Get session replay
get_session_replay.description: Return the replay metadata for a recorded session: pageCount and, per page (tab), its timing and the URL of its HLS playlist. Use get_session_replay_page to fetch one page's .m3u8 playlist, or create_session_recording_downloads for MP4 files.

output.description: Replay pages and their HLS playlist URLs.

pages.description: Recorded pages with timing and playlist URL.

get_session_replay_page.title: Get session replay page playlist
get_session_replay_page.description: Return the HLS VOD media playlist (.m3u8 text) for one recorded page of a session replay. Page ids come from get_session_replay. For a downloadable video instead, use create_session_recording_downloads.

page_id.description: The recorded page index, e.g. "0" or "1" (digits, up to 3).

create_session_recording_downloads.title: Request session recording MP4s
create_session_recording_downloads.description: Request one downloadable MP4 per recorded page of a session. Assembly runs asynchronously and every page comes back PENDING; re-posting re-enqueues all pages and retries failed ones. Poll list_session_recording_downloads for status and download URLs.

downloads.description: Entries with pageId and status (PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED, NOT_REQUESTED).

list_session_recording_downloads.title: List session recording downloads
list_session_recording_downloads.description: Return the per-page MP4 download status for a session (NOT_REQUESTED, PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED), with a short-lived signed downloadUrl and completedAt for each completed page on standard (non-BYOS) projects. Start assembly with create_session_recording_downloads.

downloads.description: Entries with pageId, status, downloadUrl and completedAt.

create_context.title: Create a context
create_context.description: Create a context: persistent browser state (cookies, local storage, cache) that sessions can load and save via create_session context_id/persist_context. Returns the context id plus the public key and cipher details used to upload encrypted state.

project_id.description: The Project ID. Optional - if not provided, the project is inferred from the API key.

name.description: Optional name for the context, unique (case-insensitive) among the project's active contexts.

publicKey.description: Public key for encrypting uploaded state.

get_context.title: Get a context
get_context.description: Fetch a context by id: its name, project and created/updated timestamps. Use create_context to make one, delete_context to remove it.

delete_context.title: Delete a context
delete_context.description: Permanently delete a context and the browser state stored in it. Sessions can no longer load it. Returns nothing on success.

id.description: The id of the context to delete.

get_extension.title: Get an extension
get_extension.description: Fetch an uploaded Chrome extension's record by id: fileName, project and timestamps. Pass its id as create_session extension_id to load it into a browser.

delete_extension.title: Delete an extension
delete_extension.description: Permanently delete an uploaded browser extension. New sessions can no longer load it. Returns nothing on success.

id.description: The id of the extension to delete.

list_certificates.title: List certificates
list_certificates.description: List the project's uploaded TLS CA certificates (id, project, timestamps). Pass their ids in create_session ca_certificates so the proxy trusts them; use get_certificate for one.

get_certificate.title: Get a certificate
get_certificate.description: Fetch one uploaded TLS certificate's record by id (project and timestamps). Use list_certificates to find ids.

delete_certificate.title: Delete a certificate
delete_certificate.description: Permanently delete an uploaded TLS certificate; sessions can no longer reference it in ca_certificates. Returns nothing on success.

id.description: The id of the certificate to delete.

list_downloads.title: List session downloads
list_downloads.description: List files a session downloaded, with optional filters on filename, MIME type, size and creation time, paged by limit/offset. Returns downloads plus total. Use get_download for one file's metadata.

session_id.description: The session whose downloads to list (required).

created_after.description: Only downloads created on or after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Only downloads created on or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

get_download.title: Get a download
get_download.description: Fetch the metadata of one file a session downloaded: filename, MIME type, size, checksum, session and time. This tool requests JSON metadata (Accept: application/json), not the file bytes. Use list_downloads to find ids.

delete_download.title: Delete a download
delete_download.description: Delete a downloaded file from storage and mark it deleted. The file cannot be recovered. Returns nothing on success.

fetch_page.title: Fetch a page
fetch_page.description: Fetch a URL through Browserbase without opening a browser session and return statusCode, headers, contentType, encoding and content. format raw returns the body unchanged, markdown converts the page to markdown, json extracts structured data matching schema. Use create_session instead for pages needing JavaScript interaction.

allow_insecure_ssl.description: Whether to bypass TLS certificate verification.

proxies.description: Whether to route the request through Browserbase proxies.

format.description: Output format: raw (default) returns the body unchanged; json returns structured data (requires schema); markdown returns the page as markdown.

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the structure to extract. Only used when format is json.

statusCode.description: HTTP status of the fetched page.

content.description: Body, markdown or extracted JSON depending on format.

web_search.title: Web search
web_search.description: Run a web search and return structured results (url, title, author, publishedDate, image, favicon) along with a requestId. Use fetch_page to then retrieve a result's content.

results.description: Results with id, url, title, author, publishedDate, image, favicon.

list_projects.title: List projects
list_projects.description: List every project the API key's organization has: id, name, owner, defaultTimeout and concurrency limit. Use get_project_usage for a project's browser minutes and proxy bytes.

get_project.title: Get a project
get_project.description: Fetch one project by id: name, owner, defaultTimeout (seconds) and concurrency limit. Use list_projects to find ids.

get_project_usage.title: Get project usage
get_project_usage.description: Return a project's usage totals: browserMinutes consumed by sessions and proxyBytes sent through proxies. Use get_project for its limits.

create_agent.title: Create an agent
create_agent.description: Create a reusable agent: a name plus an optional systemPrompt and resultSchema applied to every run that references it. Returns the agent with its agentId; start work with run_agent agent_id.

system_prompt.description: System prompt that steers the agent's behavior on every run that uses it.

result_schema.description: A JSON Schema object the run's result should conform to. Can be overridden per run.

list_agents.title: List agents
list_agents.description: List the account's custom agents, optionally filtered by creation time, with cursor pagination. Returns data plus nextCursor (null when done). Use get_agent for one agent.

start_at.description: Only return agents created on or after this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00Z.

end_at.description: Only return agents created on or before this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-20T00:00:00Z.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to start from the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null.

get_agent.title: Get an agent
get_agent.description: Fetch one custom agent by id: name, systemPrompt, resultSchema and timestamps. Use list_agents to find ids.

update_agent.title: Update an agent
update_agent.description: Update a custom agent. Only fields supplied are changed; omitted ones stay as they are. Returns the updated agent. Existing runs are unaffected.

result_schema.description: New JSON Schema object the run's result should conform to.

delete_agent.title: Delete an agent
delete_agent.description: Permanently delete a custom agent. Runs that already referenced it are unaffected. Returns nothing on success.

run_agent.title: Run an agent
run_agent.description: Start a browser agent run that completes task using web search and browser tooling, optionally as a custom agent (agent_id). Returns the run (runId, status PENDING/RUNNING, sessionId); poll get_agent_run for the result and list_agent_run_messages for its steps. A run consumes browser minutes.

task.description: A natural-language description of what the agent should accomplish.

agent_id.description: Run a custom agent you created; its systemPrompt and resultSchema apply unless overridden.

result_schema.description: A JSON Schema object the run's result should conform to. Overrides the agent's default for this run.

context_id.description: A Context ID whose browser state the agent's session starts with.

persist_context.description: Whether to save browser state back to the context after the run. Defaults to false. Only used with context_id.

proxies.description: Proxy configuration. Pass true for the default Browserbase residential proxy, or an array of proxy rules, each one of: {type: 'browserbase', geolocation?: {country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, required), state (US 2-letter code), city}, domainPattern?}; {type: 'external', server (required), username?, password?, domainPattern?}; {type: 'none', domainPattern?}. domainPattern limits a rule to matching domains; omitted it applies to all.

verified.description: Set true to enable Browserbase Verified for the run's session.

variables.description: Named variables the agent can reference as %name% placeholders, as a map of name to {value (required), description (optional hint on when to use it)}. Values are not persisted.

pause_when.description: Describe when the agent should pause for input from your application (e.g. a verification code or approval). The run then becomes PAUSED until resume_agent_run.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, STOPPED, TIMED_OUT or PAUSED.

sessionId.description: Browser session used by the run.

result.description: The run's result, shaped by resultSchema when given.

list_agent_runs.title: List agent runs
list_agent_runs.description: List agent runs across the account, filtered by status, agent and creation time, with cursor pagination. Returns data plus nextCursor. Use get_agent_run for a run's full result.

status.description: Only runs in this state. PAUSED runs await input via resume_agent_run.

agent_id.description: Only return runs that reference this agent ID.

start_at.description: Only return runs created on or after this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00Z.

end_at.description: Only return runs created on or before this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-20T00:00:00Z.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to start from the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null.

get_agent_run.title: Get an agent run
get_agent_run.description: Fetch a run's current status and details, including its result once COMPLETED, its failure cause, and the sessionId it used. Use list_agent_run_messages for the step-by-step messages.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, STOPPED, TIMED_OUT or PAUSED.

sessionId.description: Browser session used by the run.

result.description: The run's result, shaped by resultSchema when given.

list_agent_run_messages.title: List agent run messages
list_agent_run_messages.description: Return the messages a run produced (AI SDK UIMessage format), oldest first. Page or poll for new messages by passing the previous response's nextSince as since. Use get_agent_run for status and result.

since.description: The id of the last message already received; only later messages are returned. Pass the previous response's nextSince.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

all.description: Return every message after since in one response, ignoring limit.

nextSince.description: Pass as since for the next page.

resume_agent_run.title: Resume a paused agent run
resume_agent_run.description: Resume a PAUSED run with input. task is delivered to the agent as the answer to its pause request (the trailing pause tool call in the run's messages); variables merge over the run's original ones. Resuming a run that is not paused returns a conflict. Returns the run.

task.description: The reply to the agent's pause request, e.g. an answer or an approval.

variables.description: Named variables the agent can reference as %name% placeholders, as a map of name to {value (required), description (optional hint on when to use it)}. Values are not persisted.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, STOPPED, TIMED_OUT or PAUSED.

sessionId.description: Browser session used by the run.

result.description: The run's result, shaped by resultSchema when given.

stop_agent_run.title: Stop an agent run
stop_agent_run.description: Request that an in-progress run stop; it winds down and becomes STOPPED. It cannot be restarted. Stopping a finished run returns a conflict. Returns the run.

status.description: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, STOPPED, TIMED_OUT or PAUSED.

sessionId.description: Browser session used by the run.

result.description: The run's result, shaped by resultSchema when given.

list_functions.title: List functions
list_functions.description: List the project's deployed Browserbase Functions (id, name, timestamps), paged by offset/limit, with total. Use list_function_versions for a function's versions or invoke_function to run one.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get_function.title: Get a function
get_function.description: Fetch one Browserbase Function by id: name, project and timestamps. Use list_function_versions for its deployed versions.

invoke_function.title: Invoke a function
invoke_function.description: Invoke a Browserbase Function's latest version asynchronously with params. Returns the invocation (id, status PENDING, sessionId); poll get_function_invocation for status and results, and get_function_invocation_logs for logs. Each invocation runs a browser session.

params.description: JSON parameters passed to the function.

session_create_params.description: Overrides for the browser session the function runs in: extensionId, browserSettings, proxies, proxySettings, userMetadata, timeout (same shapes as create_session).

list_function_versions.title: List function versions
list_function_versions.description: List the deployed versions of a function (paged by offset/limit, with total). Each version records its build, sessionCreateParams and userParamsSchema. Use get_function_version for one.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get_function_version.title: Get a function version
get_function_version.description: Fetch one function version by id: functionId, functionBuildId, sessionCreateParams, userParamsSchema and timestamps.

list_function_version_invocations.title: List invocations of a function version
list_function_version_invocations.description: List the invocations of one function version, optionally by status, paged by offset/limit, with total. Use get_function_invocation for one invocation's results.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get_function_invocation.title: Get a function invocation
get_function_invocation.description: Fetch one function invocation: status (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED), params, results, sessionId, region and timing. Use get_function_invocation_logs for its logs.

get_function_invocation_logs.title: Get function invocation logs
get_function_invocation_logs.description: Return the logs emitted by one function invocation, with a total count. Use get_function_invocation for its status and results.

list_function_builds.title: List function builds
list_function_builds.description: List the project's function builds, optionally by status, paged by offset/limit, with total. Use get_function_build for one build and get_function_build_logs for its output.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get_function_build.title: Get a function build
get_function_build.description: Fetch one function build: status (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED), request, builtFunctions, failure cause and timing.

get_function_build_logs.title: Get function build logs
get_function_build_logs.description: Return the log output of one function build, with a total count. Use get_function_build for its status.

list_function_secrets.title: List function secrets
list_function_secrets.description: List the project secrets attached to a function (metadata only, never values), filtered by secret creation time, with cursor pagination. Attach with attach_function_secret.

start_at.description: Only return secrets created on or after this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00Z.

end_at.description: Only return secrets created on or before this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-20T00:00:00Z.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to start from the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null.

attach_function_secret.title: Attach a secret to a function
attach_function_secret.description: Attach a project secret (from create_secret) to a function; it takes effect on the next invocation. Idempotent: attaching an already-attached secret succeeds. Returns nothing.

secret_id.description: The id of the project secret to attach.

detach_function_secret.title: Detach a secret from a function
detach_function_secret.description: Detach a project secret from a function, effective on its next invocation. The secret itself is kept (use delete_secret to remove it). Idempotent. Returns nothing.

secret_id.description: The id of the secret to detach.

list_secrets.title: List secrets
list_secrets.description: List the project's secrets (id and name only, never values), filtered by creation time, with cursor pagination. Use create_secret to add one.

start_at.description: Only return secrets created on or after this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00Z.

end_at.description: Only return secrets created on or before this timestamp (inclusive). RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-20T00:00:00Z.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page. Omit to start from the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null.

get_secret_keypair.title: Get the secrets keypair
get_secret_keypair.description: Return the project's current secrets keypair id and base64 publicKey. Seal secret values to this key before calling create_secret or update_secret, and pass the id as keypair_id.

create_secret.title: Create a secret
create_secret.description: Store a project secret under a name, from a value sealed to the key from get_secret_keypair. Returns the secret's id and name; attach it to functions with attach_function_secret. A duplicate name returns a conflict.

secret_key.description: The name to store the secret value under.

sealed_secret_value.description: The secret value sealed with HPKE (RFC 9180, Base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, AES-256-GCM) to the project's public key from get_secret_keypair (base64-decode publicKey to the raw 32-byte key), with empty info and AAD, sent as standard base64(enc || ciphertext): the 32-byte encapsulated key, then the ciphertext with its tag. Never send plaintext.

keypair_id.description: The id returned by get_secret_keypair for the key that sealed the value.

get_secret.title: Get a secret
get_secret.description: Fetch a project secret's metadata (id and name). The value is never returned.

id.description: The id of the project secret.

update_secret.title: Update a secret
update_secret.description: Replace a secret's value with a newly sealed one. The name cannot change; to rename, create a new secret and delete the old one. Returns the secret's id and name.

id.description: The id of the project secret to update.

sealed_secret_value.description: The new secret value sealed with HPKE (RFC 9180, Base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, AES-256-GCM) to the project's public key from get_secret_keypair (base64-decode publicKey to the raw 32-byte key), with empty info and AAD, sent as standard base64(enc || ciphertext): the 32-byte encapsulated key, then the ciphertext with its tag. Never send plaintext.

keypair_id.description: The id returned by get_secret_keypair for the key that sealed the value.

delete_secret.title: Delete a secret
delete_secret.description: Permanently delete a project secret; functions it is attached to lose it on their next invocation. Returns nothing on success.

id.description: The id of the project secret to delete.

create_webhook.title: Create a webhook
create_webhook.description: Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive the project's function build and invocation events. The response includes the signing secret, shown only here and on rotate_webhook_secret, so store it. An endpoint can be registered only once per project.

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL that event deliveries are POSTed to. Must be publicly reachable.

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to (at least one, unique).

output.description: The webhook including its signing secret.

list_webhooks.title: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: List the project's webhooks, newest first, without signing secrets. Page with the previous response's nextCursor as cursor; a null nextCursor means no more pages.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null.

get_webhook.title: Get a webhook
get_webhook.description: Fetch one webhook by id: endpoint, subscribed eventTypes and timestamps. The signing secret is not included; use rotate_webhook_secret to issue a new one.

update_webhook.title: Update a webhook
update_webhook.description: Change a webhook's endpoint URL, its event types, or both; omitted fields stay. event_types replaces the existing subscription rather than adding to it. The signing secret is unaffected. Returns the webhook.

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL that event deliveries are POSTed to. Must be publicly reachable.

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to (at least one, unique). Replaces the current list.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete a webhook. Deliveries stop immediately and its signing secret is retired; past events are not replayed if the endpoint is registered again. Returns nothing.

rotate_webhook_secret.title: Rotate a webhook signing secret
rotate_webhook_secret.description: Issue a new signing secret for a webhook, returned only here. The old secret keeps verifying for 24 hours unless revoke_immediately is true (use that after a leak).

revoke_immediately.description: Expire the old secret at once instead of honouring it for 24 hours.
